how_this_was_made: Generated by calling the service's own tools/list handler for the customer plane — the code path the endpoint runs for a signed-in customer — on the release serving production on 2026-09-18. It is not a capture over the wire, because the customer endpoint requires a signed-in Publifye account; tool and parameter names were checked against the live documentation page, which renders from the running registry. Nothing here is hand-written. The excluded buckets are registered on the server but are not listed to a customer and are refused as unknown if a customer calls them: 'ops' is logging, health and help; 'operator' is snapshot installs, removal suppressions and key-financials maintenance; 'fleet_service' is available only to Publifye's own services and operators.

tools.name: code_list
tools.title: Code List
tools.description: Filter-value discovery with counts from the current snapshot: list org_form, municipality, nace or sector; optional query matches a code prefix or description text. Use the codes as entity_search filters. Example: code_list list=org_form query=aksje. Next: entity_search org_form=[<code>]. [END]

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.title: Entity Lookup
tools.description: Exact lookup by organisasjonsnummer in Enhetsregisteret; never fuzzy. Pass orgnr (one) or orgnrs (several, results in input order); spaces and dots are tolerated. Each item is {orgnr, found, record?, reason?} with reason invalid_checksum, not_in_snapshot or removed. Key financials (Regnskapsregisteret, latest filed accounts) are fetched only when fields includes "financials", then stored: a single orgnr waits up to 3 s; a batch answers stored figures, fetching or queue_full; over the caller's fetch budget rate_limited with financials_retry_after_seconds; repeat later. Without that request no fetch is made: stored figures are shown, else status not_requested. include_subunits adds the first 20 underenheter. live=true (single orgnr) also checks data.brreg.no: live_status current, changed (changed_fields), deleted, removed, not_found or unavailable; rate limited (rate_limited, retry_after). Sole proprietorships (ENK) never show former names or activity text to customers, and their financials only in a single orgnr lookup. A full record is about 6 KiB; with a small max_bytes use fields or compact=true. Use entity_resolve when you only have a name, entity_search for filtered lists. fields: any top-level record key (name, org_form, nace, business_address, parent_orgnr, financials, ...). Example: entity_lookup orgnr="983 887 457". Next: entity_structure orgnr=<orgnr> for parents, agencies and subunits. [END]

tools.name: entity_resolve
tools.title: Entity Resolve
tools.description: Name to organisation candidates, never an implicit pick. Compares with one documented key: NFC, lowercase, fold æ→ae ø→o å→a (oe and aa spellings also match), & → og, punctuation stripped, trailing legal forms (AS, ASA, ENK, DA, ANS, SA, STI, I LIKVIDASJON, ...) and leading STIFTELSEN/FORENINGEN/SELSKAPET removed. Tiers, first non-empty wins: exact_name (1.0), normalized_name (0.9), historical_name (0.8); only when all are empty, prefix and near_miss suggestions (at most 0.5, resolution unresolved). resolution is unique (one strong candidate), ambiguous (several; order active_first_then_enhet_then_public_body_then_orgnr) or unresolved. Zero candidates return one unresolved item with next_action entity_search. Filters: kind, public_body, municipality, include_deleted. Example: entity_resolve name="Sosialdepartementet". Next: entity_lookup orgnr=<candidate orgnr>. [END]

tools.name: entity_search
tools.title: Entity Search
tools.description: Ranked, filtered search over current and historical names, addresses and websites. Give at least one of query, address, website or a filter. Filters: kind, org_form (codes from code_list), municipality (number or name), postcode, city, nace or sector prefix, status (active by default; any for all), public_body, vat_registered, parent_orgnr, employees_min/max, registered_from/to. match: 1-4 regex terms {field, pattern} over activity, address, city, email, name, phone or website; pattern is RE2, at most 200 bytes, matched case-insensitively against the normalised (NFC, lower-cased, whitespace-collapsed) field value, and you anchor it yourself (^post anchors at the start, an unanchored pattern matches anywhere in the value, "." tests that the field is present); one pattern per field, AND'ed with each other and with every other filter; a pattern that is invalid, longer than 200 bytes, too complex or that matches the empty string (a*) rejects the call with invalid_filter. sort: relevance, name or registered_desc. Items are summaries (orgnr, kind, name, org_form, municipality, city, address, email, nace1, status, public_body, parent_orgnr, matched, score); entity_lookup gives the full record. Diagnostics state mode, ranking_version, searched/matched/dropped terms, filters_applied and empty_reason (no_query_term_in_snapshot, filters_excluded_all_matches, offset_beyond_results) with a next_action, and prefix_truncated when a short prefix matched too many terms. Customer searches without a name query never return personal-data records (sole proprietorships and their establishments); diagnostics say so, and such records carry no field values, so a match term never returns one. Follow cursor to the end of the result set; offset is a first-call convenience only. Example: entity_search query="tilsyn" public_body=true; generic company inboxes: entity_search nace="94.91" match=[{"field":"email","pattern":"^(post|info|kontakt|firmapost)[.0-9]*@"}]; two terms AND: match=[{"field":"email","pattern":"^post"},{"field":"name","pattern":"kirke|kyrkje"}]. Next: entity_lookup orgnr=<item orgnr>. [END]

tools.name: entity_structure
tools.title: Entity Structure
tools.description: Organisational structure of one orgnr as a stream of items with relation parent (overordnet chain to the root, depth 1 = direct parent, at most 20), child (enheter whose parent is this orgnr) and subunit (underenheter). section: all (default), children or subunits. A ministry lists its agencies as children; a company lists its establishments as subunits. Diagnostics carry the root summary. Example: entity_structure orgnr=983887457 section=children. Next: entity_lookup orgnr=<item orgnr>. [END]

tools.name: snapshot_status
tools.title: Snapshot Status
tools.description: Snapshot readiness and provenance: snapshot_id, acquired_at, age and stale flag, source ETag and Last-Modified per dataset, record counts (enheter, underenheter, enk, public_bodies, deleted), build and ranking version, suppression count, memory state, caller plane and access level, licence, scope and exclusions. detail=true adds per-tool latency, cursor state, suppression reconcile and removals watcher status. Memory read only. Example: snapshot_status. Next: entity_search or entity_resolve. [END]
